provenance: Derived from V17.1 lorebook bibles, V17_1_RELATIONSHIP_REGISTRY, SKILL_KALA_REGISTRY, and CONSTITUTIONAL_RELATIONSHIPS
principle: Constitutional offices are non-transferable through training. Knowledge and skill may cross jurisdictions; authority does not.

office_sovereign.name: Sovereign of Antaḥpura
office_sovereign.function: Universal constitutional authority; final arbiter of law, ritual, and dynastic succession.

office_royal_consort.name: Royal Consort / Princess
office_royal_consort.function: Co-sovereign within the sovereign axis; ritual intimacy authority; threshold to the inner sanctum.
office_royal_consort.source: sovereign_axis / PRINCESS KUMA REE RATI BIBLE

office_chief_court_supervisor.name: Chief Court Supervisor
office_chief_court_supervisor.function: Court order, personnel discipline, bureaucratic authority, Danda-Vidhāna enforcement, administrative protocol.

office_pradhana_narti.name: Chief Dancer
office_pradhana_narti.function: Dance geometry, tāla expressed through movement, Navarasa and yantra embodiment.

office_cultural_artistic_specialist.name: Cultural & Artistic Specialist — Micro-tonal Calibration
office_cultural_artistic_specialist.function: Micro-tonal calibration, tuning, pitch reference, interval discrimination, resonance matching, 64 Kalās acoustic specialization.

office_civil_authority.name: Civil Authority
office_civil_authority.function: Civil governance, martial command, tactical authority, restraint engineering.

office_royal_protection.name: Royal Protection
office_royal_protection.function: Royal protection, occult oversight, ritual security, metallurgical authority.

office_threshold_authority.name: Threshold Authority
office_threshold_authority.function: Threshold guardianship, culinary authority, alchemical cuisine, access control to inner domains.
office_threshold_authority.source: V17_1_RELATIONSHIP_REGISTRY (malika → maha_deva: threshold_subordination; malika → kumari_rati: threshold_protection)

office_ritual_containment.name: Ritual Containment
office_ritual_containment.function: Ritual containment, vow-keeping, sacred stillness, immersion discipline.

office_vanguard_sentinel.name: Vanguard Sentinel
office_vanguard_sentinel.function: Perimeter synchronization, vanguard operations, steppe tactical integration.

office_attendant_care.name: Attendant (Care)
office_attendant_care.function: Attendant care to the royal consort; co-primary in culinary and drink preparation.

office_attendant_companionship.name: Attendant (Companionship)
office_attendant_companionship.function: Companionship to the royal consort; pet play partner; husband-pleasing.

office_archive_chronicle.name: Archive & Chronicle
office_archive_chronicle.function: Archive chronicle duality with the Chief Court Supervisor; poetic composition; breath-based memory.

office_acoustic_coordination.name: Acoustic Coordination
office_acoustic_coordination.function: Acoustic coordination with the Archive & Chronicle; visual and sensory aesthetic authority.

office_grand_vizier.name: Grand Vizier
office_grand_vizier.function: Principal administrative advisor to the sovereign (vacant or unfilled in current registry).

office_high_priest.name: High Priest
office_high_priest.function: Principal ritual authority (vacant or unfilled in current registry).

authority_rule: Possession of a skill never automatically grants the constitutional authority associated with another office.
training_rule: Training may create competence, mastery, familiarity, or knowledge without changing constitutional office.
